IN MORE DETAIL

IT support, software and AI automation for businesses

HeyDock is the technology services brand of Intune Limited. We work with direct business customers and IT providers that need additional delivery capacity. Our offering combines on-site engineering, remote technical resources, ready-made business software, custom development and AI automation. The engagement may be a single authorised site visit, a software implementation or an ongoing service with defined responsibilities.

For business teams, the first question is usually what needs to work better: employee devices, customer support, internal processes or disconnected applications. For IT partners, it may be engineering availability, a rollout deadline or a customer location outside the existing team’s reach. Those are different buying needs, so our service pages explain the delivery model, prerequisites and questions to resolve before starting.

Our UK and European coverage is based on available engineers and confirmed requirements. Remote services can extend the available options, but working hours, data access and technical skills still need to match the job. We do not substitute broad geographical claims for a confirmed site booking.
